description.value: A 16-storey full-service Hilton property situated in Richmond adjacent to Vancouver International Airport. The hotel serves travellers connecting through YVR and sits within Richmond's extensive cycling network, making it a plausible overnight stop for cyclists arriving or departing by air. As a flagship Hilton brand hotel it offers a broad range of on-site services, though specific cyclist-oriented amenities could not be confirmed.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 51m; rack at 67m; rack at 74m; rack at 80m; rack at 90m; rack (covered) at 92m.
